content.title: ETF trends to watch in 2026 for active managed & derivative funds
content.description:
ETF inflows are on track to hit a fresh record high in 2025. In this installment of Yahoo Finance's ETF Report, Tema ETFs founder and CEO Maurits Pot joins Market Catalysts to share his expectations for the ETF space — particularly active managed and derivatives-based funds for crypto assets and precious metals — in 2026.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.

content.title: MoneyMasters Podcast 12-11-25- Hard Assets vs. Financial - McDonald on What Leads in 26
content.summary: Recorded LIVE at the 2025 MoneyShow Masters Symposium in Sarasota, this episode features Larry McDonald, bestselling author and founder of The Bear Traps Report. We sat down for a high-impact breakdown of the macro forces that could define 2026 – and what investors should DO in response!

content.title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights iShares Silver Trust, United States Copper ETF and Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund
content.summary: Surging industrial demand, supply squeezes and a softer dollar outlook are positioning SLV, CPER and UUP at the center of 2026's metals-driven market narrative.

content.title: Will 2026 Be a Year of Silver & Copper ETFs?
content.summary: SLV and CPER surge into 2026 as silver's supply squeeze and copper's structural demand ignite momentum. A dovish Fed and weaker dollar fuel the rally.

content.title: Copper ETF Appeal Grows Following Price Outlook Upgrade
content.summary: From tightening supply to rate-cut tailwinds and a falling dollar, everything is lining up in copper's favor. Here's why ETFs tied to the red metal may benefit.

content.title: MoneyMasters Podcast 11-13-25- The Real Drivers of the Gold Market Surge
content.summary: In this episode of the MoneyShow MoneyMasters Podcast, Brien Lundin explains why the precious metals rally is not a short burst of excitement but the start of a deeper, long-running shift in monetary and fiscal reality.

content.title: Copper Skyrockets to New Highs: ETFs to Ride the Tariff Talks
content.summary: CPER surges with copper hitting a record high in response to Trump's 50% tariff threat, with miners' ETFs like COPJ, COPP and COPA following suit.

content.title: Market Minute 7-9-25- Tariff News Rocks Copper, While Fed Chatter Heats Up
content.summary: Stocks were mixed yesterday, but it’s the metals market that got ROCKED. This morning, equities are modestly higher along with Bitcoin. Most other markets – including Treasuries, the dollar, and crude oil – are flattish.

content.title: CPER Sinks as China, Dollar  Tariffs Weigh on Copper
content.summary: - Trade tensions and demand worries are among catalysts contributing to recent dip in copper prices. - However, weakness in the industrial metal may be short-lived as the long-term outlook still shines.

content.title: Copper Hits a Three-Month High: ETFs in Focus
content.summary: Copper hit a three-month high near $10,000/ton as tight supply, strong demand, and trade optimism fuel gains. Tap CPER and COPX.
